blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to Buenos Aires Airport for your flight home.

You will remember Rio for the white sands of Copacabana on New Year's Eve, Iguazu for its humid air and the constant roar of the water, and Buenos Aires for its historic neighbourhoods and evening tango.

Over the course of the journey, you will visit two countries, welcome the New Year beside the ocean and explore the trails on both sides of Iguazu Falls. The itinerary also leaves room for free days, so the trip does not become an endless succession of early departures and excursions.
